newsitem.title: USA: Koss Corp sees boost from new products.
newsitem.headline: Koss Corp sees boost from new products.

text.p: Koss Corp said Wednesday it expects the 21 new products it is introducing will contribute to its results in the second half of fiscal 1997 and into the next fiscal year.
The new products, such as stereophones, will be introduced this week at the Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas.

Michael Koss, president and chief executive officer, said the consumer electronics sector of the retail industry has reported inconsistent results following the holidays. He added this was reflected in a 35 percent drop in its royalty income from electronics products compared to last year.

"Despite this inconsistency in retail performance we remain optimistic, and feel that our 21 new product offerings will give us another boost during the remaining six months and into the first six months of our next fiscal year beginning in July," Koss added.
Earlier, Koss Corp reported earnings for the second quarter ended December 31 of $0.45 a share, up from $0.22 a year ago. Sales rose to $13.3 million from $9.9 million.

"The company's earnings per share for the three months (second quarter) has eclipsed the six month performance of last year and earnings per share for the first six months of this year have now exceeded last year's complete 12-month total," Koss said.
In fiscal 1996, ended June 30, Koss earned $0.67 a share.
Koss Corp makes high fidelity stereophones, active noise cancellation headsets and loudspeakers.
